capabilities: Open week, month and year calendar views in a tab
Create events that are written as Markdown notes in the vault
Write daily reviews and use a class timetable
extras: Desktop only because the page renders in an iframe; data is also cached in browser localStorage, so the README advises exporting before switching machines; makes no network requests; ZJU timetable sync is deliberately disabled in this build.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar view for scheduling events, deadlines and habits that also writes the data back into the vault as plain Markdown.
summary: Full calendar in an Obsidian tab with week, month and year views, timetable, deadline countdown, habit and mood tracking, saved as Markdown notes.
